title: Normalized Detection Record
description: The single, tool-agnostic shape every detection source (ZAP today, sslyze/testssl.sh later) normalizes into. Produced by the normalizer (FR-N1); consumed by the SARIF exporter (FR-X1) and lifecycle diff (FR-L2).

app_id.description: Ties the detection back to its scope.json. MUST match scope.app_id.

scan_id.description: UTC timestamp id of the scan run (e.g. 20260909T114855Z). Also names the evidence directory (FR-E1), so the format is frozen.

fingerprint.description: sha256 of rule_id|endpoint_pattern|parameter|payload_family. Stable identity used by the lifecycle diff (FR-L2).

rule_id.description: Source rule identifier. From ZAP pluginId.

title.description: Human-readable detection name. From ZAP alert name.

severity.description: Normalized severity. Mapped from ZAP risk. Ordered high->low so the SARIF exporter maps deterministically.

cwe_id.description: CWE identifier where available (FR-N1). NULL when the source omits it - do not drop the field.

endpoint.description: The affected URL/endpoint. From ZAP url.

parameter.description: Affected parameter. NULL when not parameter-scoped (e.g. header/transport findings). Empty-case is a fixed sentinel so fingerprints stay stable (FR-N2).

status.description: Lifecycle state assigned by the diff against the previous scan's fingerprint set. 'resolved' is asserted only when the finding's (route x rule) pair was actually exercised this scan; 'not_scanned' marks a previously-open finding whose (route x rule) pair was not exercised this scan (coverage-driven disappearance, not a confirmed fix) — see R2 in docs/junior_engineer/seeded_session_exploration_design.md.

evidence_path.description: Relative path to the evidence artifact (HAR/screenshot) under the scan_id evidence dir. NULL if none captured.
